prompt: In a quiet library reading room rendered in anime style, sunlight filters through tall windows onto polished wooden floors. On the left side of the frame, a girl with twin braids sits cross-legged on a plush rug, her eyes wide with curiosity as she holds an open book. Next to her, a fluffy white cat sleeps soundly, its tail curled neatly around its paws. In the center, a boy wearing round glasses stands beside a towering stack of hardcover books, pointing enthusiastically at a specific spine while explaining something to his companion. To his right, a woman in a blue cardigan listens intently, nodding slightly as she adjusts her spectacles. Behind them, near the back wall, an elderly man in a tweed jacket reaches up to pull a volume from a high shelf, his posture slightly stooped but determined. In the foreground on the right, a young child in a yellow raincoat sits on a low stool, drawing quietly in a sketchbook with a bright red crayon. The girl with twin braids is looking at the boy with round glasses, creating a sense of shared discovery. The fluffy white cat is sitting on the rug next to the girl, adding warmth to the scene. There is no digital technology such as laptops or smartphones visible anywhere in the room, preserving the timeless atmosphere of printed knowledge and quiet study. The composition balances the vertical lines of the bookshelves with the horizontal spread of the readers, emphasizing the peaceful coexistence of different generations within this sanctuary of literature.
